name: live-announcer
title: Live announcer
description: One place to tell screen readers what just happened: mount LiveAnnouncer once, then announce polite or urgent messages from any component with a hook.
docs: Mount <LiveAnnouncer /> once, as a sibling of your app's main wrapper rather than inside it, so a modal that hides the app does not hide it. Then call announce('3 results found') or announce('Upload failed', 'assertive'), or take the same function from useAnnounce(). Both regions exist from the first render, a message is written by emptying and refilling its region so repeats are read again, identical messages sent within 600 ms count as one, and the rest are read in turn. clearAfterMs empties a region after a message; onAnnounce reports each message that was written, for a visible log. A no-op on the server.
